summary: Tested the new Deal Contacts feature end-to-end. Backend: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_deal_contacts.py — 13/13 tests pass serially (admin CRUD, owning-client CRUD, RBAC for foreign client + lender read-only + unauthenticated, custom_type validation, field normalization/trim/lowercase/loan_number blanking, 404s on all 4 verbs and unknown cid, audit events via Mongo AND /api/admin/audit-log, public token-gated /api/lender-view/{token}/deal-contacts + 404 for unknown token). Frontend: verified Client Portal panel (add title contact, custom type with label, mortgage loan number, switch-type clears loan #, edit, delete with window.confirm, mailto/tel links, modal portal-rendered into document.body and in-viewport), Admin console 'Contacts' tab (add/edit/delete + persists across reload), and token-gated LenderView (read-only panel above Documents, no Add/edit/delete controls). All TEST_ data cleaned up (scenarios now have 0 deal_contacts).

critical.issue: Unlike every other /lender-view/{token}/* endpoint (which calls _require_view_session(token, session_token)), this endpoint requires no view session — anyone holding/guessing a share link can read all outside-party PII (company, contact person, email, phone, loan number, notes) WITHOUT accepting the confidentiality gate, and the read is never recorded via _log_view. Verified: plain GET with no auth/session returns 200 with full contact list.

minor.issue: Lost-update race: handlers read the whole deal_contacts array and $set it back. Reproduced under a concurrent (pytest-xdist) run — a PATCH returned 404 'Contact not found' because a concurrent write replaced the array. Use $pull for delete and positional/arrayFilters $set for update instead of rewriting the array.

An invalid type (e.g. 'bogus_type') is silently coerced to 'custom' and then fails with 400 'Please provide a label for the custom contact type' — misleading. Prefer 422/400 'Unsupported contact type'.

PATCH behaves as a full replace (any field omitted from the body is blanked). Acceptable for the current modal (always sends all fields) but semantically wrong for a PATCH and fragile for future API consumers.

ui_bugs.issue: Spec expects toast 'Give the custom contact a label…' on empty custom label, but the label input has HTML5 required=true so the browser blocks form submit and NO toast/inline message appears — the user just sees the modal do nothing (native tooltip only, and it is easy to miss). Either drop required and let the toast fire, or add a visible inline error.
Empty catch block on reload() swallows errors (eslint no-empty error at line 54) — a failed reload after save/delete leaves stale data with no user feedback. Also an unused eslint-disable at line 43.

integration_issues.issue: GET /api/scenarios/{sid}/deal-contacts supports role=lender (editable=false, verified by pytest) but DealContactsPanel is only wired into ClientPortal, AdminScenarioDetail and LenderView — LenderPortal has no Deal Contacts panel, so that backend branch is unreachable from the UI.

issues: The new 2-col grid lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_320px] squeezes the docs column to ~420px while doc rows still use md:flex-row (viewport-based breakpoint), so doc labels/notes wrap one word per line at 1920px (e.g. 'Loan / Executive / Summary', 'Note / from / broker: / Auto- / generated…'). Either stack doc rows below a container width, move the panel full-width under the docs list at <xl, or apply the 2-col grid only at xl+.
Duplicate heading: page section header 'Deal Contacts' immediately followed by the panel's own 'Deal Contacts' card header + subtitle.

action_items: Gate GET /api/lender-view/{token}/deal-contacts behind _require_view_session (pass session_token from LenderView's fetchUrl) and log the view via _log_view.
Make PATCH/DELETE atomic on the embedded array ($pull / arrayFilters) to avoid lost updates.
Fix custom-label validation UX (remove required or show inline error so feedback is visible).
Fix client portal docs-column squeeze introduced by the new 2-col grid.
Return a clear error for unsupported contact types instead of coercing to custom.
Remove empty catch block / unused eslint-disable in DealContactsPanel.jsx.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1992 — new public token endpoint bypasses the confidentiality gate used by all sibling /lender-view endpoints; PII exposure + no audit trail.
server.py:1928-1988 — read-modify-write of scenarios.deal_contacts is not atomic (reproduced 404 under concurrency).
DealContactsPanel.jsx:46-55 — reload() swallows all errors silently.

rca_of_the_issue: Lender-view PII gap: the new endpoint queries scenario_shares by token only and returns contacts, skipping _require_view_session/_log_view that all other /lender-view/{token}/* handlers use. Concurrency 404: update/delete handlers snapshot scen['deal_contacts'] then $set the entire array, so a concurrent insert/delete between read and write is lost, causing subsequent operations on the lost contact to 404.
